meaning:
οἰκτείρω
(οἶκτος, pity), [in LXX for רָחַם pi., חָנַן, etc. ;]
to pity, have compassion on. with accusative of person(s), Rom.9:15 (LXX).†
SYN.: ἐλεέω, q.v (AS)

elsewhere.note: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”
